minutes_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA HISTORIC PRESERVATION COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  February 26, 2025

The audio and video recordings of the meeting are available here: HPC Meeting – February 26,
  2025 (Audio) / HPC Meeting – February 26, 2025 (Video)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  6:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Amaro

  Absent:  Littlefield

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director of Community Development; Maia
  McCurley, Principal Planner; Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant; Greg
  Murphy, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Amaro

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – JANUARY 22, 2025 (6:01 P.M.)
  •  Request: This is a request for the Historic Preservation
  Commission to approve the Minutes of the January 22, 2025,
  Regular Meeting of the Alhambra Historic Preservation
  Committee.
  •  Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the January 22, 2025, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission.
  •  Commissioner Ng commented that he had originally voted for
  Option B for Historic Preservation Ordinance Provision #1
  (Historic Resources Survey List/Inventory), but has changed his
  position and actually prefers Option A with the caveat to allow
  owners to opt out for a specific amount of time.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Chen, Seconded by Commissioner Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  1
  2/26/2025
 AGENDA
ITEM 2:  DRAFT HISTORIC PRESERVATION ORDINANCE (6:08 P.M.)
  •  This is a continuation of the discussion on the options for how to
  proceed with the Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Historic
  Preservation Commission consider and discuss, as needed, the
  80 comments that were submitted by Commissioners on revisions
  to the Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance, and arrive at
  consensus (simple majority) on substantive revisions to the Draft
  Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff
  presentation.
  •  The City’s consultant, Historic Resources Group (HRG), and
  sub-consultant, Architectural Resources Group (ARG),
  provided the presentation.
  •  The public comment portion of the Discussion Item was
  opened and closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation on comments #1-13
  (green category) on revisions to the Draft Historic Preservation
  Ordinance.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Vice President
  Michelson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

MOTION:
  •  Moved to appeal the Chair’s decision to move on without allowing
  for questions by the commissioners.
  •  Moved by Vice President Michelson. The motion was not
  seconded.
  •  The motion did not carry.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to include the following Historic Preservation incentives in
  response to comments #14-17 (yellow category) as revisions to
  the Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance: (1) Mills Act tax
  abatement program; (2) California Historical Building Code; (3)
  Exemption from design review; (4) Residential waiver for garage
  space requirement; (5) Recognition/plaque program; (6)
  Reduction of building permit fees with the reduction to be set by
  City Council.
  2
  2/26/2025
   •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Commissioner Chen.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

MOTION:
  •  Moved to include the following Historic Preservation
  enforcement/penalties in response to comments #18-19 (yellow
  category) as revisions to the Draft Historic Preservation
  Ordinance: (1) Unauthorized demolition/alteration declared a
  nuisance; (2) Permit moratorium up to 24 months to study
  appropriate mitigation; (3) Attorney may maintain an action for
  injunctive relief; (4) Additional “penalties and violations” provisions
  already included elsewhere in the Alhambra Muni Code
  (incorporated by reference); (5) Increase proposed permit
  moratorium to 60 months; (6) Requirements for reconstruction or
  restoration per the Standards; (7) No permit authorizing new
  structure exceeding original square footage, lot coverage, or use;
  (8) Fine penalties to be set by City Council; (9) If owner fails to
  comply, City will cause such work to be done at the cost of the
  owner.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Commissioner Chen.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

ORIGINAL MOTION:
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation on comments #20-23
  (blue category) and not include these revisions to the Draft
  Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Chen, Seconded by Commissioner Ng.

SUBSTITUTE MOTION:
  •  Moved to pull comments #22 and #21 for discussion.
  •  Moved by Vice President Michelson. Motion was not seconded.
  •  The substitute motion did not carry.

  •  The original motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-1-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Amaro
  Noes:  Michelson
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield
  3
  2/26/2025
 ORIGINAL MOTION:
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation on comments #24-50
  (orange category) and not include these revisions to the Draft
  Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Commissioner Chen.

SUBSTITUTE MOTION:
  •  Moved to pull comments #46 for discussion.
  •  Moved by Vice President Michelson. Motion was not seconded.
  •  The substitute motion did not carry.

  •  The original motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-1-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Amaro
  Noes:  Michelson
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

  •  Recess at 7:56 P.M.
  •  Reconvene at 8:07 P.M.

MOTION:
  •  President Amaro pulled comments #72 and #59 for discussion.
  •  Commissioner Ng pulled comments #73 for discussion.
  •  Vice President Michelson pulled comments #51, #52, and #53 for
  discussion.
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation to not move the balance
  of the comments #54-58, #60-71, and #74-80 (red category)
  forward as revisions to the Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Chen, Seconded by Commissioner Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

MOTION:
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation on comment #51 (red
  category) and not include these revisions to the Draft Historic
  Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Chen, Seconded by Commissioner Ng.
  •  President Amaro proposed a Friendly Amendment to take into
  consideration the addition of language related to “adaptive reuse”
  in the Findings of Fact, accepted by Commissioner Chen.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  4
  2/26/2025
   Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

MOTION:
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation on comments #52 and
  #53 (red category) and not include these revisions to the Draft
  Historic Preservation Ordinance, with the caveat that this
  language will be included in the Findings of Fact.
  •  Moved by Vice President Michelson, Seconded by Commissioner
  Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

MOTION:
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation on comment #59 (red
  category) and not include these revisions in the Draft Historic
  Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Moved by President Amaro, Seconded by Commissioner Chen.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Ng, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  Michelson
  Absent:  Littlefield

MOTION:
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation on comment #72 (red
  category) and not include these revisions in the Draft Historic
  Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Moved by President Amaro, Seconded by Commissioner Chen.
  •  The motion did not carry.
  •  The Commission agreed to move forward with a split vote.

  Roll Call Vote: 2-2-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Amaro
  Noes:  Ng, Michelson
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

ORIGINAL MOTION:
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation on comment #73 (red
  category) and not include these revisions in the Draft Historic
  Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Chen. Motion was not seconded.
  •  The original motion did not carry.
  5
  2/26/2025
   ALTERNATIVE MOTION:
  •  Moved to require that major and minor alterations to all resources
  and potentially eligible historic districts are not exempt from
  historic preservation review in response to comment #73 (red
  category) and incorporate this requirement as a revision to the
  Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Vice President
  Michelson.
  •  Commissioner Ng withdrew his motion. Vice President Michelson
  withdrew her second.

  ALTERNATIVE MOTION:
  •  Moved to accept staff’s recommendation on comment #73 (red
  category) and not include these revisions in the Draft Historic
  Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Chen, Seconded by Vice President
  Michelson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-1-0-1
  Ayes:  Chen, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  Ng
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Littlefield

F.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Jennifer Ng thanked the Commission, staff, and the consultants for all of the
  hard work put in on the Historical Preservation Ordinance. (9:36 P.M.)

G.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 9:45 P.M. to
  Wednesday, May 28, 2025, at 6:00 P.M.
